recipes.name: Seasoned seaweed (Gim-muchim: 김무침)
ingredients: 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds, plus a little extra for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, mix the seasoning sauce ingredients together until well incorporated.
Tear the sheets of gim with your hands into small pieces over the seasoning sauce and gently toss all together.
Transfer to a serving plate or bowl. Serve with rice and other side dishes, or pack in a lunchbox.
